ART AS PROTEST: Visual artist Sim Tolentino paints a mural on the Freedom Wall at the University of the Philippines Diliman on Saturday, April 18, 2026. The artwork, which depicts a leader pointing at the viewer surrounded by words such as “conflict,” “terror,” and “oil business,” serves as a pointed commentary on the intersection of power and war amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East.
